properties.description: Traditional 1.5-storey Scottish vernacular stone farm steading and cottage with whitewashed harled masonry, pitched Scottish slate roof, and dormer windows

materials.facade: Whitewashed lime harling over Scottish granite/schist rubble masonry
materials.roof: Ballachulish dark grey slate with stone ridge tiles and lead flashing
materials.fenestration: White-painted timber sash windows and timber entry doors

rectification.vertical_plumbing: True gravity vertical on all harled wall elevations
rectification.ridge_alignment: Sharp linear ridgeline running east-northeast with crisp dormer projections
rectification.eaves: Clean timber fascias and cast-iron half-round rainwater goods

properties.description: Large agricultural barn complex with gabled roof, corrugated sheeting, and attached open-sided tractor sheds

materials.facade: Vertical profiled steel cladding and timber weatherboard lower skirts
materials.roof: Weathered corrugated fiber-cement and steel roofing with integrated translucent skylight panels
materials.ancillary_wings: Oxidized corrugated tin roofs on timber pole frames

rectification.vertical_plumbing: Straightened structural post lines and planarized expansive roof slopes
rectification.ridge_alignment: Level apex ridges with sharp gable ends

properties.description: Unpaved farm access track and working yard composed of compacted crushed granite aggregate, sand, and tyre ruts leading into open pasture
properties.surface_treatment: Rutted gravel, exposed subsoil, patchy verge turf

properties.description: Undulating Strathspey glacial drift and alluvium over Dalradian metamorphic bedrock, supporting lush green highland grazing pasture
properties.micro_ecology: Scottish highland grasses, occasional broom scrub, gorse bushes, and distant heather margins
